# Architectural Legacy of the Palace of Justice of the Argentine Nation

## Summary

The Palace of Justice of the Argentine Nation is a historic building located in Buenos Aires, Argentina, and its architectural design has been attributed to various architects. The building's construction spanned from 1898 to 1906, with the Italian architect Vittorio Meano being credited with its design. However, the completion of the building is attributed to Argentine architect Julio Dormal. The Palace of Justice is an iconic landmark in Buenos Aires, known for its stunning architecture and rich history. This research brief aims to identify the architect responsible for building the Palace of Justice of the Argentine Nation.
